extracted.intended_audience: corporate communications teams, PR professionals, and marketers seeking multichannel press-release distribution and branded landing pages
extracted.subtask_description: Creating and distributing branded multichannel news releases (MNRs) that combine multimedia assets, custom landing pages, and paid/earned distribution to reach target audiences and drive engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Custom Landing Page (branded)
rubrics_metrics.description: A custom-branded landing page built by a dedicated team of web designers and project managers to showcase content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used as the hub for multichannel promotion; showcases multimedia and company branding; intended to elevate messaging from a simple press release to a shareable pitching tool.

rubrics_metrics.name: Press Release Distribution (wire transmission)
rubrics_metrics.description: Full national wire transmission to 14,500 websites, media outlets and journalists, with international distribution options available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Included as core distribution; delivers earned reach through wire channels and media contacts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multimedia Assets (count limits)
rubrics_metrics.description: Ability to display multimedia assets on the MNR (Standard: up to 6 assets; Basic: 3 assets).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Multimedia can include images, video, infographics and is central to making the release shareable and engaging.

rubrics_metrics.name: Choice of Influencer List
rubrics_metrics.description: Option to distribute the MNR to an additional Cision Influencer list.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enables targeted outreach to influencers beyond standard wire/media lists to increase earned/social visibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lead Generation / Call-to-Action Integration
rubrics_metrics.description: Integrate your own or have one built for calls-to-action; supports click-throughs to your site, social channels and more.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to capture audience response and drive direct actions from the MNR; can be customized for campaign goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Guaranteed Page Views
rubrics_metrics.description: Guaranteed minimum page views for the MNR (Standard: 10,000; Basic: 5,000).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reach new audiences via contextual audience targeting; a guaranteed metric for campaign reach and value.

rubrics_metrics.name: Online Video Distribution
rubrics_metrics.description: Distribution of one video file to top video portals such as YouTube, Vimeo and AP Video Hub.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Extends video reach beyond the landing page to major video platforms for broader discovery and SEO benefits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Guaranteed Paid Placement (GPP)
rubrics_metrics.description: Paid placement guaranteeing coverage in top online media outlets (publisher sites) that can't be reached by wire alone.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When combined with an MNR (MNR Pro), provides an earned+paid distribution solution delivering editorial-style content on targeted publisher sites to industry audiences; presented as the most effective placement format for reaching certain online sites.

rubrics_metrics.name: Package: Standard MNR (feature set)
rubrics_metrics.description: Standard MNR combines paid, owned, shared and earned media strategies and includes: custom landing page, press release distribution, up to 6 multimedia assets, choice of influencer list, lead generation/CTA, 10,000 guaranteed page views, and online video distribution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Positioned as the most popular option for communicators to elevate messaging and create a shareable pitching tool; emphasizes cross-channel promotion and engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Package: MNR Pro (feature set)
rubrics_metrics.description: MNR Pro couples the MNR with Guaranteed Paid Placement to guarantee coverage in top online outlets and deliver editorial-style content on publisher sites.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides both earned (wire/landing page) and paid distribution to reach publisher audiences that wire cannot; marketed for stronger industry-targeted reach.

rubrics_metrics.name: Package: Basic MNR (feature set)
rubrics_metrics.description: A budget-friendly MNR that includes a branded landing page, press release distribution, lead generation, influencer list, 3 multimedia assets, and 5,000 guaranteed page views.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pared-down option for lower budgets while retaining core components of an MNR.

rubrics_metrics.name: Autoplay Video
rubrics_metrics.description: Automatically playing video clips on page load to drive views and engagement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to immediately capture attention; cited as a feature to increase engagement metrics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mouseovers / Dynamic Image Animations
rubrics_metrics.description: Dynamic image animations that respond to mouseover and encourage clicks and engagement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Interactive imagery to prompt user interaction and increase time on page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Content Blocks (mixed media layout)
rubrics_metrics.description: Layout capability for mixed media content (text and assets), suitable for posting event calendars, food menus, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Organizes diverse content types for readability and usability on the landing page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Page Load Animations
rubrics_metrics.description: Fades, slide-in animations that encourage the visitor to scroll through the page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design affordance to guide user attention and improve content discovery on long pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Animated Infographics
rubrics_metrics.description: Ability to animate static data into various animated displays such as bar graphs, line graphs, and pie charts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Transforms data into engaging visualizations to communicate metrics or trends more compellingly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Custom Icons / Branded UI Elements
rubrics_metrics.description: Custom play buttons and social share buttons that match the client’s brand.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintains brand consistency across interactive elements and social functionality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Font Matching
rubrics_metrics.description: Ability to use client-provided fonts to tailor the look and feel of the page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensures typographic brand consistency between the MNR and the client's other channels.

rubrics_metrics.name: Guaranteed Distribution (general claim)
rubrics_metrics.description: Every MNR includes multimedia assets, company branding and guaranteed distribution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Core promise of the product: that distribution and branding elements are included as part of the offering, forming the baseline quality expectation for an MNR.
